articles.title: Aave chief defends protocol's 'resilience' after $8.45 billion bank run
articles.snippet: The founder of the largest DeFi platform blamed "third-party” entities for decentralized finance’s vulnerabilities, while independent data highlights severe gaps in Aave’s own risk architecture.

articles.title: CME is letting traders bet on bitcoin volatility, not price, and two firms have already placed bets
articles.snippet: Monarq and DV Chain kick off trading in CME's bitcoin volatility index futures.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls back below $63,000 as Iran-Israel trade strikes and Korean stocks crash
articles.snippet: BTC has pulled back from overnight highs as escalating geopolitical tensions weigh over risk sentiment and send oil price higher.

articles.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs bleed $1.7B as outflow streak hits four weeks
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s IBIT accounted for most of the weekly Bitcoin ETF redemptions, while Fidelity and Grayscale funds also saw outflows.

articles.title: ETH falls to 13-month low on Zcash bug, Bitcoin below $60K: Is $1.4K next?
articles.snippet: ETH price crashed below $1,600 as a vulnerability in Zcash emerged and Bitcoin sold off below $60,000 for the first time in months.
